inputs.modified_text: A “No Kings” rally against Trump ended the way these confrontational political spectacles often do: crowds filled the streets, agitators faced off with authorities, and police ordered people to disperse. Federal officers used tear gas and made arrests; at least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. Whatever the protesters’ slogans, no cause gives anyone a license to turn public streets into a battleground. A society that respects law and order cannot treat this kind of chaos as just another political performance.
